info.title: API.SH: Letterboxd
info.description: The Letterboxd API from API.SH: public Letterboxd data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
A film on Letterboxd: title, original title, year, tagline, synopsis, runtime, average rating with rating and review counts, poster, backdrop, directors, cast with characters, crew by role, studios, countries, primary and spoken languages, alternative titles, genres and themes, every release (type, date, country, certification, note), IMDb and TMDB ids, and the page's popular reviews (author, rating, likes, comments, spoiler flag, excerpt, link). With `include=stats` it also returns `watch_count` (members who watched it), `list_count` (lists it appears in), `likes`, `top500_rank` (its place in the Letterboxd Top 500, else null), and, when available, `fans` and `rating_histogram` (count and percent per half-star rating; null when not available).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/letterboxd-film

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: The film's slug from letterboxd.com/film/<slug>/, e.g. `parasite-2019`.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: `stats` adds member statistics (watches, lists, likes, Top 500 rank) and the ratings histogram with fans when available (slower).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/letterboxd-person

parameters.description: Role (default actor, or the one in the link).

get.description:
Member reviews of a film on Letterboxd, 12 per page: id, author, username and profile link, avatar, star rating, whether the member liked the film, watched date, rewatch and spoiler flags, review text (long reviews are cut where the site cuts them), likes, comments, language and link. Sort by popularity, date or rating. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/letterboxd-reviews

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: Film slug (the part after letterboxd.com/film/), e.g. `parasite-2019`. Give `slug` or `url`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/letterboxd-user

parameters.name: username
parameters.description: Username, the letterboxd.com/<username>/ part; a profile link also works.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: Letterboxd member films, diary, watchlist or likes
get.description:
A Letterboxd member's watched films (with their star rating, review and like marks), diary (watch date, rating, rewatch, review link), watchlist or liked films. Filter watched films by rating or year/decade; sort by date, name, release, rating, popularity or length. Pass `next_page` back as `page`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/letterboxd-user-films

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort order (default newest; not for diary).

parameters.name: rating
parameters.description: view=films: only this rating (e.g. 4, 3.5) or none.

parameters.name: year
parameters.description: view=films: only films from this year (2024) or decade (1990s).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
